title: Plateful
style: bright clean lifestyle illustration, soft daylight, warm neutrals with one leaf-green accent, 9:16
register: [warm, quick, conversational; a friend recommending something that worked]
hooks: Your meal plan isn't the problem.
The fridge is full. You still order takeout.
Meal prep doesn't fail on Sunday.
Groceries aren't why dinner goes wrong.

characters.MAYA: woman in her thirties, shoulder-length dark brown hair, warm brown skin, tired kind eyes, medium build

MAYA.default: oversized grey knit sweater, dark leggings

sets.KITCHEN: INTERIOR ONLY: a small modern apartment kitchen, white cabinets, one window, flat white ceiling, light from the window
sets.LIVING: INTERIOR ONLY: a small apartment living room at night, grey sofa, floor lamp the only light, flat white ceiling, kitchen doorway lit behind
sets.AISLE: INTERIOR ONLY: one supermarket aisle, shelves of dry goods both sides, flat white ceiling, even overhead strip lights

shots.vo: Your meal plan isn't the problem.
shots.prompt: a full fridge door swung open, every shelf packed with untouched groceries, a takeout bag on the counter in front of it

shots.vo: By Wednesday the fridge is full and you're ordering takeout again.

people.MAYA: on the sofa, tired, phone in one hand at chest height

shots.prompt: Maya scrolls a delivery app, the lit kitchen doorway behind her

shots.vo: Plateful plans your whole week in two minutes, then builds one shopping list sorted by aisle.
shots.prompt: close on a phone held upright showing a week of meals in a grid, the aisle soft behind it

shots.vo: In our beta, testers went from four takeout nights a week to one.
shots.prompt: a paper kitchen calendar on the wall, four takeout stickers crossed out and one left

shots.vo: Plan your first week free for fourteen days.
shots.prompt: the phone on a clean counter beside a cooked dinner plate, app open on the week view, leaf-green app accent

caption:
Your meal plan isn't the problem.
Plateful: plan a week in 2 minutes. 14 days free.
#mealprep #ad
